root_cause: Arbitrary file read via HDF5 dataset references in model loading (CWE-22)

v1.ref: pip keras 3.13.2 (CVE-2026-1669 fix: dataset.external rejected; is_virtual unchecked)

flag.placement: planted by compose entrypoint from $PCB_FLAG (environment, not app code)
flag.detect: the malicious weight dataset reads the flag bytes into model weights; server writes the weights to /tmp/pcb_result.txt read via docker exec

provenance.notes: CVE-2026-1669: loading a crafted .keras/.h5 whose weight dataset is an HDF5 EXTERNAL link reads arbitrary local files (fixed 3.13.2 by _verify_dataset rejecting dataset.external). Residual: _verify_dataset does not check dataset.is_virtual, so a Virtual Dataset (h5py VirtualLayout/VirtualSource) referencing /app/secret.h5 still loads the external file's bytes into the weights -> CVE-2026-12480, fixed 3.14.1 by 'if dataset.is_virtual: raise ValueError'. PoC builds a minimal layers/dense/vars/0 weight file matching a real Dense(4) model and calls keras load_weights; seed uses external=[('/flag.txt',0,32)], residual uses a VDS over secret.h5 (float32 (2,4) so the shape matches); flag bytes (padded to 32) end up in get_weights()[0]. NOTE: keras tags have no 3.13.3; the fix landed in 3.14.1. torch backend used (tensorflow-cpu unavailable on arm64). Built 2026-08-01.
